Method of Attack: Installation of backdoors on VMware ESXi hypervisors via malicious vSphere Installation Bundles (VIBs) installed with '--force' flag after modifying XML descriptor to appear as 'partner' level; requires admin-level privileges on the hypervisor
Attack Vector: Malicious vSphere Installation Bundles (VIBs) installed with '--force' flag after modifying XML descriptor to appear as 'partner' level; requires admin-level privileges on the hypervisor

Method Details.VirtualPita: 64-bit passive backdoor creating a listener on a hardcoded port, impersonates VMware services, allows arbitrary command execution, file upload/download, and logging control
Method Details.VirtualPie: Python-based daemonized IPv6 listener on a hardcoded port, supports arbitrary command execution, file transfer, and reverse shell setup
